profileSelection.rule: Host selects implementation and trusted binding; wire profile is an expected constraint. Exact registered id+version, mode, required capabilities and extensions must match before mutation. No last-wins/default on failure.
profileSelection.capabilityIds: open namespaced strings, never a closed kernel enum
profileSelection.unqualifiedIO: Missing and Central deny default tenant IO; Central uses explicit named control ports only. Disabled facility with an active framework store requires explicit shared owner+purpose declaration or boot fails.
profileSelection.qualification: Profile declarations are requirements, not evidence of support. Host extensions must pass applicable corpus; installing a plugin alone advertises nothing.

profiles.concurrency: one sequential lane; no interleaved fibers
profiles.guarantee: frame/lifetime/cleanup discipline; no isolation guarantee for arbitrary IO
profiles.binding: host trusted synthetic binding mandatory for tenant mode; central carries no resource identity

profiles.guarantee: one nonempty stable identity and verified host resourceRef/incarnation; fresh admission at every enter; no multi-resource switch
profiles.binding: synthetic host binding is permitted without physical IO; never Central/null

profiles.concurrency: FPM/CLI/sequential worker; pm.max_requests=1 for first FPM qualification
profiles.guarantee: PG16 DB-per-resource with actual marker verification before IO; enabled facilities each require their own IO qualification

profiles.concurrency: one physical writer per resource; session advisory lock on pinned maintenance DB of frozen cluster
profiles.guarantee: operation/receipt/reconcile/recovery only after physical qualification; additive host capability, not a selectable runtime mode

toolchain.composerConstraints: P2.1 manifests must stay inside these lanes; concrete dev tool versions/locks and lab commands owned by P1.3, package locks by scaffolding/qualification. No dependency is installed by P1.1.
toolchain.vendoredTenancy: none selected; no stancl/Spatie runtime owner. Historical branch comparison is not adoption/qualification.

facilities.controls: named central metadata/auth/jobs/failed-jobs connections remain fixed; raw SQL through guarded tenant connection; transaction/cursor blocks switch
prefix from trusted descriptor, not product id; Redis IO required for multi-process isolation
trusted host route before session IO; auth/admission after session; keep frame through save/terminate; host-secure ID cookie parameters
trusted root/prefix; path traversal/symlink guards; tracked stream lease; raw path unavailable in guarded profile
explicit mode/frozen intent, pre-hydration enter, framework-attempt completion after all scoped callbacks
invalidate scoped services on every transition and restore; old handles never revive after A-B-A
exact protocol tenant.binding/1; one selected physical owner; no sibling catalog reads

facilities.slot: host-specific; distinct slot per independent product scope
facilities.controls: relation validation after resource activation, common journal; no second executor; per-frame state
optional; never a second writer beside CoreX at runtime-only checkpoint

streamPolicy.api: TrackedStream read/write/close check generation; borrowed native stream only inside synchronous callback; never returned to application. Raw path() refuses unsupported_capability.
streamPolicy.switch: outstanding tracked stream/cursor/transaction on affected binding refuses enter/restore before mutation with open_resource
streamPolicy.boundary: unclosed stream/token is fatal frame_leak: quarantine/poison and stop worker before sentinel; run cannot return successful result with leaked stream
streamPolicy.escape: arbitrary fread on escaped PHP resource or direct absolute path IO cannot be guarded; trusted-host escape outside qualified profile only, no portable guarantee

extensions.unknownOptional: bounded decode then ignore without effects, never reclassify a required extension
extensions.known: exact registered type+version and handler allowlist; duplicate type rejected; typed refs validated after resource activation
extensions.product: basic A/W validation mandatory for FlexCRM; company/employment/city/commercial policies conditional, owned by product

EXT-01.contract: open capability + resolver decorator + explicit replacement, no kernel imports

EXT-02.contract: permutation-stable compile, slot/dependency/cycle/version/late errors before prepare

EXT-03.contract: frame-local state, two hooks, reverse started journal and poison

EXT-04.contract: post-publication observations, isolated observer/diagnostic errors, reentry refusal

EXT-05.contract: one runtime owner across facade/provider/decorators; same corpus for replacement

EXT-06.contract: tracked stream switch refusal, fatal boundary leak; no raw path/stream guarantee
